quivering.line: If you see my lip start quivering
stanza: If you see my lip start quivering

shivering.songTitle: One of Us Cannot Be Wrong
shivering.line: The poor man could hardly stop shivering
stanza: An Eskimo showed me a movie
The poor man could hardly stop shivering
His lips and his fingers were blue
I suppose that he froze when the wind took your clothes
And I guess he just never got warm
But you stand there so nice in your blizzard of ice
Oh, please let me come into the storm
